prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: portrait handbag moodboard for the Bags N-Z review and iOS app. Create a polished vertical 2:3 editorial product moodboard accurately capturing the current The Attico handbag direction. Center the sculptural Milanese attitude and asymmetric La Passeggiata day-bag construction, not generic nightclub mini bags. Show six distinct products: a large black grained-leather asymmetric day tote with inverted panels, tubular handles and geometric feet; a medium coffee-brown croc-embossed horizontal top-handle bag; a small khaki suede asymmetric tote; a washed light-blue denim mini; a compact fuchsia smooth-leather mini; and a pearl-grey or platinum rounded architectural top-handle bag. Add only detail crops of triangular feet and outward-facing seam geometry. Use pale-grey and warm-white studio paper with restrained cobalt and red accents, no people. High-end Italian product photography with calf leather, suede, croc embossing, denim and brushed metal. Make asymmetry visible and every bag different. No typography, logos, labels, captions or watermark. Avoid rhinestone pouches, repeated trapezoid mini bags, chainmail purses, triangular baguettes, nightclub scenes, repeated models and duplicate colourways.
refinement_notes: Replaced generic nightlife minis with the asymmetric La Passeggiata family, varied sizes and materials, tubular handles, inverted seams, and geometric feet.
